description: Piazzetta — Colore: Celadon green & beige Codice: 5410 Materiale: 100% Cotton Disegno: Classic Scala: Medium Altezza: 140.5 cm Rapporto: 35 cm × 58 cm Toni: Green The Venetian Rococo painter Giovanni Battista PIAZZETTA was renowned for religious subjects and genre scenes, which he painted with rich color, curvaceous forms, and graceful charm. PIAZZETTA’s mystical expressiveness is emphasized by large floral lozenges, which seem to wrap their arms around you as they hold bountiful floral bouquets.
